ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High ratio of high-intensity pixels (white) to low-intensity pixels (black); approximately 70:30 distribution with white dominating the central lobes and black concentrated at the peduncle and perimeter.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central low-intensity triangular anchor at the peduncle transition; high-intensity lobes with irregular low-intensity perimeter banding; isolated low-intensity linear and point-like clusters scattered across both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped central indentation with a deep vertical pixel depth dividing the lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular trailing edge with high-frequency micro-peaks; significant jagged serrations clustered at the distal fluke tips; moderate undulation along the medial boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical concave curve fitted to the trailing edge, sweeping dorsally and laterally from the median notch to the tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized clusters of high-contrast low-intensity pixels at the distal fluke tips and scattered across the trailing edge margins.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct vertical low-intensity rake-like streaks visible on the medial-right lobe; multiple smaller, unaligned linear disruptions on the lower-left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive irregular low-intensity scarring/pigmentation at the fluke tips; scattered punctate marks across the ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Noticeable yellowish-tan chromatic shift in the high-intensity regions of the central lobes, distinct from the pure white pixels.
